name: Arrive Hakone

name: Hakone Open-Air Museum
notes: 2 hrs. Don't miss stained-glass Symphonic Sculpture tower and Picasso pavilion. Discounted with Hakone Freepass.

name: Tamura Ginkatsu-tei
notes: Tofu Katsuni - fried tofu stuffed with minced meat. Line up at opening.

name: Hakone Craft House
notes: Glass beads experience (1.5 hrs). Pre-book online. Rated 4.8 stars.

name: Amazake Chaya Tea House
notes: 400-year-old teahouse run by same family for 13 generations. Order amazake and sesame mochi. Cash only!

name: Hakone Day 2
notes: Last day in Hakone - 3-Day Pass

name: Lake Ashi stroll
notes: Walk the shoreline. Mt. Fuji views weather permitting. Spot the Peace Torii gate.

name: Hakone Sightseeing Cruise
notes: Iconic cruise boat. Consider upgrading to first class for deck access. Covered by Hakone Freepass.

name: Ashinoko Skyline Rest House Lake View
address: Ashinoko Skyline Rest House Lake View, Hakone, Kanagawa
notes: Open 9AM-5PM with lake views

name: Hakone-no-ichi Shop
notes: Sweet potato snacks and souvenirs. Open until 8 PM. Discounts with Hakone Freepass.

name: Train from Odawara to Kyoto
notes: Train from Odawara to Kyoto (1 hr 43 min). Need to purchase tickets.

name: Arrive Kyoto
notes: Check in to Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Shinmachi Bettei

name: To-ji Temple
notes: Historic Buddhist temple with 5-story wooden pagoda. Open 8AM-5PM.

name: Nishiki Market
notes: 400-year-old iconic market with stalls offering Japanese edibles.

name: Kiyomizu-dera
notes: Iconic Buddhist temple on Mount Otowa. Open 6AM-6PM.

name: Nidec Kyoto Tower
notes: Observation deck with binoculars & touch-screen guides. Open 10AM-9PM.

name: Okochi Sanso Garden
notes: Elegant tranquil Japanese gardens with scenic views & tea house. Open 9AM-5PM.

name: Hozugawa River Boat Ride End Point
notes: 2-hr riverboat ride with oars & bamboo poles past rapids. Open 9AM-3PM.

name: Arashiyama Park Kameyama Area
notes: Scenic area known for cherry blossoms in spring.

name: Arashiyama Bamboo Forest
notes: Sightseeing path through towering bamboo stalks.

name: Hokyo-in
notes: Temple in the Sagano area of Arashiyama.

name: Jojakkoji Temple
notes: Buddhist temple in a serene forest with views. Open 9AM-4:30PM.

name: Kyoto Gyoen National Garden
notes: Large park surrounding the Kyoto Imperial Palace.

name: Kankame Inari-jinja Shrine
notes: Inari shrine in Kyoto.

name: Saihoji (Kokedera) Temple
notes: Zen Buddhist temple with extensive moss garden. Requires advance reservation.

name: Kyoto Botanical Gardens
notes: Expansive botanical garden showcasing exotic plants. Open 9AM-5PM.

name: Shimogamo Shrine
notes: Legendary 2000-year-old shrine in a tranquil riverside forest. Open 6AM-5PM.

name: Tadasu-no-Mori Forest
notes: Peaceful forested park with cherry & plum trees and walking paths.

name: Nara Park
notes: Public park with ancient temples & Nara National Museum plus tame deer.

name: Uji
notes: City known for Byodo-in Temple and green tea. Travel guide: decafjournal.com/uji-nara-japan-travel-guide/

notes: Check in to Onsen Ryokan Yuen Bettei Tokyo Daita

name: Bar Benfiddich
notes: Cocktail bar in Shinjuku.

name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
notes: Former estate now a 144-acre park with diverse gardens & greenhouse. Open 9AM-4PM.

name: teamLab Borderless
notes: Immersive museum with futuristic digital art installations. Open 8:30AM-9PM.

name: Nakano Broadway
notes: Shopping center for anime & comics plus boutiques and eateries. Open 10AM-8PM.

name: Hachigatsu no Kujira - The Whales of August
notes: Bar/restaurant near the hotel.

notes: Prominent 1649 Shinto shrine. Hosts Sanja Matsuri festival in May.
